text:
Cynicism has no limits.

They imprison you, they beat you,

they isolate you in punishment dungeons

with rats, cockroaches

and other filth,

and on top of it they complain

because you scream.

translation.title: Cynicism Has No Limits...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the blunt indictment of carceral cruelty and official complaint.
